description: THE SOUTH GATE. The Gate Road climbs to a throat of scorched rockcrete where the Architect's Curtain parts — a single lit gap in a floor-to-heaven wall of humming hard light that seals the city's whole southern edge. Twin turret masts flank the opening, barrels sweeping the killing ground beyond in slow, patient arcs. Grey-uniformed perimeter guards work the gap under a caged amber beacon, waving traffic through and logging every soul that walks south — because most of them don't walk back. The city is behind you. The wild, and everything past it, is through the throat. The gate is open. It's the going that costs you.

flags.gate_warning: One of the grey-uniformed gate guards steps into your path before you reach the throat of light. "Hold up — I don't know your face, so you'll hear this once. Nobody walks the waste without it." She tips her head at the Curtain, where the Gate Road simply ends. "Past this wall there's no road, no rescue, and no clone-vat waiting on you if it goes bad out there. It's open killing ground — the turrets sweep it, the wind moves it, and it buries its own. Most who walk south don't walk back. Carry water. Carry people. Don't carry a warrant." She thumbs at two smudges on the far horizon. "Two places worth reaching, if you must. South, past the deep waste, lies The Reach — an air-town that takes the kind the city won't. East is Exodus, for those done with allegiances. Everything between is just the going." She steps aside and waves you toward the gap. "That's your warning. Feet forward — and don't look back for whoever falls."

name: The South Gate
